description: This file defines multiple interfaces and classes related to transaction attribution in the Orleans framework, including various attribution grain interfaces and extension methods for obtaining and wrapping attribution grains.

classes.name: TransactionAttributionGrainExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IGrainFactory and wrapper classes implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain for each attribution option.

classes.name: NoAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for INoAttributionGrain, implements ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: SuppressAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for ISuppressAttributionGrain, implements ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: CreateOrJoinAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for ICreateOrJoinAttributionGrain, implements ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: CreateAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for ICreateAttributionGrain, implements ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: JoinAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for IJoinAttributionGrain, implements ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: SupportedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for ISupportedAttributionGrain, implements ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: NotAllowedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for INotAllowedAttributionGrain, implements ITransactionAttributionGrain.

methods.name: GetTransactionAttributionGrain
methods.description: Factory method to obtain an attribution grain wrapper based on the specified transaction option.

methods.name: GetNestedTransactionIds
methods.description: Method declared in ITransactionAttributionGrain interface, used for retrieving nested transaction IDs.
